chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet entrance into the cave: a few water-drip bell notes echo in the dark, a low bass root swells in, then the lead floats the first notes of the theme into the space}
positive_styles: thin pulse-wave lead with a drifting melody in cavernous reverb
thin echoing pulse-wave lead with a drifting melody
bright bell and glass-chime figures like light glinting on cave water
soft brush stroke once per bar like a wave washing in
calm glittering sea-cave, becalmed and wondering, quietly magical
